# Bus Priority Impact Studio

Bus Priority Impact Studio publishes route-first evidence pages for NYC bus priority planning.

## Public pages

- [Route priority overview](https://bus-priority-impact-studio.c20carroll.workers.dev/)
- [M15 SBS route evidence page](https://bus-priority-impact-studio.c20carroll.workers.dev/routes/m15-sbs)
- [Network map](https://bus-priority-impact-studio.c20carroll.workers.dev/map)
- [Intervention timelines](https://bus-priority-impact-studio.c20carroll.workers.dev/interventions)

## API

- [OpenAPI 3.1 contract](https://bus-priority-impact-studio.c20carroll.workers.dev/api/openapi.json)
- [Route cards](https://bus-priority-impact-studio.c20carroll.workers.dev/api/v1/studio/routes)
- [M15 SBS route profile](https://bus-priority-impact-studio.c20carroll.workers.dev/api/v1/studio/routes/m15-sbs)
- [M15 SBS speed history](https://bus-priority-impact-studio.c20carroll.workers.dev/api/v1/studio/routes/m15-sbs/speed-history)
